class.name: ViewSystem
class.brief_description:
Demo C++ system exercising cached [code]View[/code] and change-aware [code]ChangeView[/code] iteration.
演示用 C++ 系统：演练缓存的 [code]View[/code] 与变更感知的 [code]ChangeView[/code] 迭代。
class.description:
An example system compiled into the extension. It builds a cached [code]World::view<Position>[/code] and a change-aware [code]ChangeView<Position>[/code] in [code]_setup[/code], then counts the entities seen by each on every tick. Demonstrates compile-once views and change-aware iteration.
一个编译进扩展的示例系统。它在 [code]_setup[/code] 中构建一个缓存的 [code]World::view<Position>[/code] 与一个变更感知的 [code]ChangeView<Position>[/code]，随后每帧统计各自看到的实体数。演示了编译一次视图与变更感知迭代。

method.name: get_changed_count
method.description:
Returns how many entities the change-aware view reported on the last tick.
返回变更感知视图在最近一次驱动中报告的实体数量。

method.name: get_view_count
method.description:
Returns how many entities the cached view saw on the last tick.
返回缓存视图在最近一次驱动中看到的实体数量。
